reviews.author: Hannah Lindqvist
reviews.title: Exactly as described
reviews.text: Ordered the oak sideboard, arrived in four days, assembly instructions were actually readable. No complaints at all.

reviews.author: 郭俊霖
reviews.title: 品質好，物流可以再快
reviews.text: 傢俱本身沒話說，接縫處理得很細。唯一小缺點是物流業者只給一天前通知，臨時要調整上班時間有點麻煩。

reviews.author: Daniel O'Connor
reviews.title: Fine, nothing special
reviews.text: Product is decent for the money but the website photos make the finish look warmer than it actually is. Not a dealbreaker, just be aware.

reviews.author: 許雅雯
reviews.title: 客服回應很快
reviews.text: 詢問保固範圍，客服十分鐘內就回覆並附上條款連結，不用來回追問，體驗很好。
